content: EA-side heartbeat pattern: Python writes/sends a timestamp or sequence id each cycle; EA tracks last-received time and treats the link as dead if no update within a threshold (commonly 30-60s), entering a 'manage-only' mode (apply stops, close by time, no new entries) until the link recovers. Disconnection without an EA-side watchdog can leave open positions unmanaged until broker-side stop loss triggers, confirming the EA must own stop-loss enforcement independent of the Python link.
